descriptionHtml:
Elevate your evening look with this stunning Applique Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Evening Dress! Featuring delicate floral appliques and romantic ruffle sleeves, this dress flows gracefully with every step. Perfect for formal events or a night out, it combines elegance and charm for an unforgettable entrance!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
